title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 冬至(Winter Solstice)是全年白昼最短、黑夜最长的一天，标志着一年中最寒冷时节的开始。冬至过后，气温越来越低，人们的户外活动逐渐减少。农民地里活儿不多，主要忙于灌溉系统的维护和农作物的防冻，同时为来年春天播种做准备。 中国人历来很重视冬至，许多地方都把冬至当作一个节日，庆祝方式各地不尽相同。北方人有冬至吃饺子(jiaozi)的习俗，南方人有冬至吃汤圆(tangyuan)的传统。
reference: The Winter Solstice is the day on which daytime is the shortest and night is the longest in the whole year, marking the beginning of the coldest period of the year. After the Winter Solstice, the temperature drops lower and lower, and people's outdoor activities gradually decrease. Since there is not much work to do in the fields, farmers are mainly busy with maintaining the irrigation system and protecting crops from freezing, while preparing for next spring's sowing. Chinese people have always attached great importance to the Winter Solstice and regard it as a festival in many places, though the ways of celebrating it vary from place to place. Northerners have the custom of eating jiaozi on the Winter Solstice, while Southerners have the tradition of eating tangyuan on this day.
